orthogonal_array_impossibility_proof.summary_reason: Because 4, 9, and 11 are pairwise coprime, any strength-2 orthogonal array OA(N, 4^1 9^1 11^1) requires lcm(4*9, 4*11, 9*11) = lcm(36, 44, 99) = 396 | N (and even strength-1 equal marginal replication requires lcm(4, 9, 11) = 396 | N). No fractional OA with N < 396 exists mathematically, and the PromptEval MMLU catalog observes only 89 of 396 cells (missing 307 three-way cells, 2/36 op*space pairs, 3/44 op*sep pairs, and 31/99 space*sep pairs, with sep=']' observed only 5 times).
